description: Make a checkout link for a real custom cross stitch kit of the person's photo from Cross Stitched: printed pattern chart, pre-sorted DMC threads, Aida fabric, needles and instructions, delivered. The person pays on the Cross Stitched checkout; nothing is charged by this tool. Give pattern_id (from create_cross_stitch_pattern) or photo_id.

fabric_count.description: Default: the count used for the pattern, else 14.

kit_size.description: Kit size, e.g. "12x16". Default: the size used for the pattern, else 12x16.

photo_id.description: Photo code (ph_...) from the upload page, if no pattern was made.

name: order_custom_kit
title: Order a custom cross stitch kit
